reason: Provides agent tools to search, list, and read past or current DeepSeek Harness sessions through the runtime sessionQuery service, with read-only access and bounded scan behavior.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 的 sessionQuery 服务搜索、列出和读取过去或当前的会话内容。
summaries.en: Provides read-only agent tools for searching, listing, and reading past or current DeepSeek Harness sessions through the runtime sessionQuery service.

capabilities: Searches indexed or scanned DeepSeek Harness sessions
Lists past and current DeepSeek Harness sessions
Reads session metadata and events by session ID
Accesses session content through the read-only sessionQuery service
